key_insight: VN-GraphGG separates grain-growth kinetics from microstructure reconstruction, using the von Neumann–Mullins law on a graph and a GNN to rebuild the evolving polycrystal.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster two-dimensional grain-growth simulation with adjustable kinetic coefficients, supporting efficient studies of process-structure-property relationships in materials.
method: Represent the polycrystalline microstructure as a graph with grain nodes and junction nodes.
Evolve grain areas with the von Neumann–Mullins law on the grain graph.
Use a graph neural network to reconstruct microstructure and handle topology changes via reconstruction/postprocessing.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports accurate prediction of VN kinetics and coarsening statistics, plus significant speedup compared with phase-field simulations, including an abnormal grain-growth example.
watch_item: The approach is presented for two-dimensional grain growth, so extension to more complex 3D microstructures and robustness to strong heterogeneity may require further validation.
paper_title: VN-GraphGG: von Neumann--Mullins--based graph grain growth simulation
